newsletter.subject: Quillmarsh beats and raises
newsletter.text:
EARNINGS WRAP

Quillmarsh Foods reported third-quarter revenue of $1.2 billion, up 8% from a year earlier, as frozen meals kept selling despite price increases. Operating margin came in at 11.5%, compared with 10.2% a year ago.

The company raised its full-year revenue guidance to $4.7 billion from $4.5 billion. Chief executive Dana Orvell said input costs had "finally stopped climbing".

Shares rose 6% in after-hours trading.

This newsletter is for information only and is not investment advice.
